title: Mother MCP — Tech Stack Detection and Auto-Provisioning of AI Coding Skills
description: MCP server that auto-detects a project's tech stack and installs relevant AI coding skills automatically. Also consolidates fragmented AI instruction formats (CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, copilot-instructions.md, etc.) into a unified source of truth, preventing instruction drift across tools. Addresses the CLAUDE.md monolithic file scaling problem.

matches: Rules Directory with paths: frontmatter (conditional loading)
redundancy_check.verdict: NOVEL — Rules Directory provides conditional loading but still requires manual skill creation and installation. Mother MCP's auto-detect-and-provision pattern is distinct: it reads project context and fetches/installs relevant skills without manual configuration.
redundancy_check.key_distinction: Rules Directory: conditionally loads already-existing rules. Mother MCP: discovers what rules/skills the project needs and fetches them from a registry automatically.

evaluation.reasoning: Auto-provisioning is genuinely novel and the CLAUDE.md consolidation angle addresses real friction (we have CLAUDE.md across 59 projects + global ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md). Token efficiency benefit is real: auto-detected relevant skills means less irrelevant context loaded. Key concern: privacy risk (sending project code to skill-provisioning service) and conflict with existing CLAUDE.md hierarchy. Source confidence is MEDIUM (HN secondary source). Research needed: find GitHub repo, verify whether skills come from a public registry or are project-local, assess privacy model.
